rationale: Luke brings deep full-stack AI engineering expertise and conviction around LLM tooling and adaptive learning systems, while Sharon is building production-ready AI agent infrastructure at TheAgentic.Ai — both working in the LLM-tooling domain but at different layers of the stack. This is a natural skill and domain complement: Luke's technical foundation in Python, TypeScript, and ML infrastructure paired with Sharon's focus on agentic AI systems could spark ideas around how learning platforms might leverage agent-based approaches, or how agent infrastructure could power educational use cases.
intro_message: Luke Bechtel, meet Sharon — you're both working on LLM tooling infrastructure from different angles (adaptive learning vs. production agent systems), and your complementary technical backgrounds could make for a good brainstorm at the hackathon.
